Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at IIT(ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Assistant post is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Data Science to be eligible for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Assistant post announced by IIT(ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email only.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Which department or institute is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad (IIT(ISM) Dhanbad).

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Project Assistant recruitment is SRDP 1267 I.
